about: Born from KUNOS Simulazioni's long-term experience in recreating top-grade driving simulations, Assetto Corsa Competizione allows you to feel the real atmosphere of the GT3 championship, competing against official drivers, teams, cars & circuits…

Using sophisticated mathematical models, the engine carefully simulate tyre grip, aerodynamic impact, engine parameters, suspensions and electronics systems that determine vehicle balance, as well as the influence of mechanical damage on the car's…
Sprint, Endurance and Spa 24 Hours races come to life with an incredible level of realism, in both single and multiplayer modes.
Offering photorealistic weather conditions and graphics, night races, motion capture animations, it's a new standard in terms of driving realism and immersion.
There's no better time than now to #beACC.
Assetto Corsa Competizione is coming to PlayStation 5 on the 22/02/22. Improved frame rate and upgraded visuals gives racers the most immersive racing experience to date.
